<user_input mode="act">In Applicant Management:
- Interview Scheduling section/tab:
• In the Interview Calendar card can you remove the dot or . (below of the date) in the calendar.
• In the Interview Calendar card can you make the indicator (Free day(schedulable), Full (all slots booked), Booked, Today, Not schedulable / No availability) justify in the card width don't make the card adjust width just justify the position of indicator.
• In the Interview Calendar card can you allow to have make a hover effect in the calendar.
• In the Book an Interview card make this info or button "On-site Interview
Location: Oxford Suites Makati, HR Office, 3rd Floor
No applicant selected Aug 21 at 08:00 AM Ana Ramos
Confirm & Send Invitation" bottom of the card but make that the card are not adjust height.
• In the Book an Interview card add a position combobox and it must based in the department also make sure that the department and position are fetch

- Ranking & Applicants section/tab: 
• In the add applicant modal step 2, fetch all department and applying for combobox based on the database also I want in the department and applying for combobox indicator for each department/position if they already posting a job post.
• In the resume screening result in add applicant step 3 and in the review, I want the png,jpg,pdf,docx that are uploaded their preview are in the 100% zoom. Also if the docs/docx are not seen convert to pdf to seen it or preview.

- History & Audit section/tab: 
• Add generate report button for generating report right side of users dropdown filtering and it must generate a pdf, docs, excel and must be professional output or content.</user_input>
